reviews.text: Difficult to use. I downloaded the app, signed in and then it asked for my location so I put my zipcode. It doesn’t show show the Sprouts location that’s near me, it kept giving me the location that’s more than 10 miles away, even when I typed my address. And then, it wouldn’t allow me to add a shopping list/shop unless I choose a location. I am not going to a store that’s more than 10 miles away if there’s one that’s just miles from me. So I deleted the app, what good is an app if I can’t even see their store flyer?

Nope. 👎. After several years of not using the app and deciding to re-download it NOTHING has changed: the bugginess still hasn’t been fixed, and there is still no iPad compatibility… so I don’t use this app, and just use the website. 

So annoying. 🙄

Great store, glitchy app. Sprouts is great and I love being able to shop in their app directly.
BUT it glitches so much.

App stinks. The app refuses to open in the store. I’d like to sign in that way instead of typing my phone # I. The keyboard is not only difficult to see because it is shoved way up under a cover but then I can’t watch the cashier ring up my purchases. The prices are not always correct especially on sale items.

complaint. the app
specifically makes an ad pop up over the rewards barcode after a few a seconds so you’re forced to look at it and close it to use the barcode! very annoying!
What Rewards?!. Useless except for using it as a shopping list. Coupons are on items I never buy and they don’t give you rewards for the items you do purchase.
Something went wrong. Definitely a glitch in the app. I keep trying to open it and get hit with a message that says “something went wrong”. I can’t access the app at all
Not working at all. I downloaded the app and all it does it saying something went wrong and that someone was notified.

Fake deals- don’t fall for them!!!. I just downloaded the app to make it easier to keep track of items I occasionally need from Sprouts, and I’m already annoyed seeing the “sales” and “deals”. For example, there is currently one plastered on the home page of the app saying “3 day sale BOGO mix and match chocolate bars”. If you do the math, they’ve inflated the price of all the chocolate so that when you buy two, you literally are paying full price for both. Proof? Sure. You can normally buy a Hu chocolate bar for roughly $4.50. Right now on the app they are $6. Half of $6 is $3. So when you apply the BOGO coupon, you pay a total of $9 (full price for two bars regularly), but they trick you into thinking you paid less than $12 which LOOKS like a deal. So what actually happened? They inflated the price to literally manipulate the consumer into believing they got a great deal, when in reality they got played. A REAL BOGO deal would be buying a bar for $4.50 and then getting the second for $2.25 for a grand total of $6.75. It’s such a shame that Sprouts pulls this. It’s exactly what other large retailers do these days because they’re so disgustingly greedy and stingy that they would rather trick their loyal customers than give honest savings. Don’t fall for these sales because if you do, it encourages them to continue their scams. Take the time to research and learn these tactics to avoid these bs “deals”. The ONLY reason I’m giving two stars instead of one is because I appreciate that Sprouts carries certain items that would otherwise be much harder to find anywhere else.

What did you do with my grocery list???. There’s nothing MORE FRUSTRATING than getting to grocery store, opening up the app, and NOT SEEING THE LIST I JUST MODIFIED THE NIGHT BEFORE!!! I USED to use this app when shopping. NOW, my list is GONE!!! Whatever new update you all decided to make completely erased my whole list and moved everything into my cart. I do not order online. I don’t even use that option. I NEED MY GROCERY LIST!! Please fix this. 
Unfortunately for you, I would’ve spent more money in your store…… had you not erased my list. SMH.

reviews.text:
iPad app. I do online ordering a lot since I’m taking care of my mother. It’s a very nice feature that Sprouts offers. I wish though they would make an iPad app that works. The app that’s on the iPad seems like it’s intended for the phone. It only does portrait mode and won’t let me enlarge the screen. If I go to sprouts via the browser it pushes me to the sprouts app. So I delete the app on the iPad since it sucks. 

Another issue with the app. When I go to pay it always ask me to verify the card I want to use. When I enter the security code it doesn’t like it. Says my payment can’t be verified. I have to go into my account delete the card re-enter the card and then accepts it. It has the zip code pre filled out which is the zip code for the store, not the zip code for the card. I don’t know if that’s why it’s not letting my card go through.

Makes shopping so much easier. We eat an animal based diet and sprouts is awesome for quality pasture raised Duroc pork, legacy chicken and grass fed beef. We do not use grain based foods or anything with seed oils. Its hard to avoid soy and canola at most store but Sprouts shows ingredient list quite clearly.
Doh!. First time download. Glitch won’t accept email address. Unable to create account.

Annoyingly unusable. Opened the app, searched for a product, got an overlay popup for something completely unrelated. Started scrolling through search results. Immediately got another “Hosting?…” popup for something I didn’t even care to read. Dismissed the popup. Scrolled through few more results. Got the same useless popup again. Deleted the app and ordered what I was looking for from Amazon.
Unable to create an account. I am unable to create a Sprouts account. I tried several time I ever had a Sprouts employee to help me. They need to update their app.

No Bonus Points. I really like shopping at Sprouts, but their rewards system is awful. Recently, I found out that I was not getting the bonus points - only base points - even though I have met the minimum requirements for the various offers. I have written to customer service multiple times, but to no avail!
It just displays the webpage. Barely an app. Just opens the sprout’s webpage. Can’t even login. Shopping at Trader Joe’s instead.
Great app, just one thing…. Please make a save for later option for items in the cart! That would be helpful.

Fix the scrolling issue on the order substitutions page. The page to pick substitutions for an order is broken. You can’t scroll without it jumping around all over the page, it makes defining substitutions nearly impossible.

No Notification Options, Spam. They don’t provide a settings panel to choose which notifications you want. This is a trashy app design decision. I’ll use the website if I need something from Sprouts again.

Missing or hidden notification preferences. I never expected dark patterns from a grocery store app, but I had to totally turn off ALL notifications in the Apple notification settings, because the app does not provide any notification preferences that I could find to turn off advertising or promotional notifications. Even the Sprouts Farmers Market Notification Settings link at the bottom of the Apple notification settings page takes you to a page in the app that only lets you control order notifications.
Bags. There is no way to request No Bags when doing a pickup.

Ripped us off - this is Instacart, not Sprouts. Will not use this app again. We had a pickup and returned items to the store just after receiving the pickup as we found we had to many. The store took the returns but made us use the app to get a refund. Instacart runs the app and wouldn’t refund us.
App no longer works. I can’t sign in from my iPad to do anything.

App not working. I download the app, and it’s stuck in the 3 intro billboard about the app. There’s no way past it. I’ve hard closed and still nothing. No buttons, clicked everywhere, and nothing. Not a great start, but hopefully it will get fixed.
Broken app, frozen from onboarding. Screen froze and not moving anywhere and no option to get in

App does not work after update. App used to work flawlessly in the past. But after the latest update, it does work at all. All you get are 3 info screens and nothing else. Deleted it 3 times and reloaded 3 times, same result. Will shop somewhere else.

Literally can’t log in or do anything. Just downloaded and you can’t do anything. It has you swipe through “sign up”, “order groceries”, and “view weekly ad” but then literally can’t click or do anything… such a bad design but also doesn’t function
Can’t get in. What’s up w the app? it wants me to sign up - gives me 3 pages of “why” but doesn’t let me get out to shop? I deleted and reloaded - same thing … help
App not opening. App not working

Annoying Notification That Can’t Be Removed. Good app but they send you a lot of notifications about ideas that you can’t opt out of or turn off in the settings. This is very annoying because no one wants to see bogo ads on their phone.
Fresh fruits and vegetables. Also meats filet minong. Greatest.. Excellent foods.

A few bugs. When I am picking up an order the but says “let us know your coming” and the following screen says it will notify staff I’m on my way but it actually says I’m at the store. Also, the in app pickup window is typically several hours shorter than the one I’m given in my text notification
Owned by Instacart. This app is owned by Instacart, so expect the same issues. High fees and last-minute order cancellations literally about 30% of the time.

Out of Stock!. I love Sprouts, but this app doesn’t show accurate inventory. Ordering with Instacart delivery is useless. An article recently said that Instacart’s failure to integrate inventory is the biggest barrier to sales. It hurts retailers like Sprouts. But why doesn’t Sprouts just show inventory in the app themselves? It is useless to spend time shopping in the app, only to be constantly messaged by the shopper about things being out of stock and whether to substitute. The app options for choosing substitutes would not be needed if you just showed us the honest stock levels! SHADY! It is much easier to just go in and shop myself! Of course I would buy more if the app made my life easier. It does not. Spending 25 minutes messaging about replacement items is frustrating. When the key items are out of stock, I feel tricked. Trust in the app & ordering is lost. Deleting. Boo 👎

App can be better. The app needs an option for being in stores. Gives you the option for in store pick or delivery (both have a charge). 
It should have the option to be able to check if they have it at the store(the quickest option) so that customers can go pick it up.

Enjoy app platform. I’m enjoying the app platform. It’s easy to use and to maneuver through, however I’d like to see my receipts whether that’s from in-store purchases or online. Is that something that’s already available or am I just missing it when I’m using app?

Can’t log in anymore. I’m not able to sign into my account anymore. I don’t know how many points I have. I can’t use coupons. Every time I sign in, it brings me to the homepage as a guest so I can’t use any of the perks of being a member.
Fix the Add To Order button. So frustrating that the Add To Order button never works. This app is so glitchy
0 stars. If I could rate this app a 0 I would. Can’t even get it to link with my work perk.

Ridiculous. Typing an item into the search bar is stupid. If you'll don't carry it just say the item is unavailable. I don't need to see every single possible item you'll sell besides what I'm looking for.

UGHHH. Wanted to love this app. Tried placing a delivery order twice only for them to both get cancelled. How do they expect us to be in constant communication with shoppers? I am a new mom. I can’t just go shopping when I need to. And I’ve needed things from them asap. They cancel my order cuz I don’t respond to a shopper in a quick manner!

reviews.text: Purchased a lot, used my #, app shows zero points. Why are my points not showing? I spend thousands of dollars at sprouts

Everything fixed. I blasted this app pretty hard in my previous review, but it appears that they have fixed all the issues. 

There are no longer ‘sponsored’ search results when you’re looking for items, and the app correctly determines the nearest Sprouts store. Putting together a grocery list for in store shopping is incredibly easy, and unlike others (Publix), they have no problem showing the prices of items in the app. 

This is now one of the best grocery store apps on the App Store, and even though it’s more than double the distance to other grocery stores, I’ll be making the drive to Sprouts.

Total waste of time. For some unknown reason the loyalty card disappeared from my digital wallet. I can’t sign in to my account when I download the application. I’ve reached out to customer service who took 3 weeks to send me an email to respond they would look into the problem, then nothing. If I hit forgot password I get no reply and every time I go to the store the clerk tells me I have 2 accounts yet I can’t access either. So can’t use coupons or create a list which was helpful. This is a total disappointment and make one have absolutely no loyalty to the store itself. I know I’ve personally cut my shopping there down to have to have and I can only get it there instead of my regular store.

Eh. I like what you're selling but I got confused at checkout in store because the cashier was pushing the $2 cash back so much I really thought when I scan the QR code after making an account I'd get it back but it excludes prior purchases. Oh add a verify password option to your sign up cuz I wrote my password down then it didn't work when I tried to sign in the first time. It was really frustrating. Your app keeps showing me blank screens too btw, it's kinda janky.

The employees don’t come out till you’ve clicked, “I have arrived.” I’ve seen other mentions of this problem in the reviews. Can’t this be fixed?

reviews.text: No Rewards Points. Sprout’s cashier told me I should download the app so I can get rewards points. So I go home, download the app, create an account, and on my next visit the cashier asks if I have the app. I tell her I do, she scans my bar code, but I never receive the points. I contact customer service and they tell me rewards points are not available in my area. I then ask why is their cashier telling customers to download the app to receive points? Their response was, “Our cashiers let customers know so that when we roll out rewards to your location you're already signed up and ready to start earning! We apologize for the confusion…” Cashier shouldn’t be telling customers they’ll get rewards when they aren’t available. Seems like Sprouts just wants to track my purchases without providing the benefit of the rewards points.

reviews.text: Great selections. Lots of great selections but too expensive.

Quality food.. Friendly customer service. 
Excellent prices on better quality food than the typical grocery stores.

Justgrits1 on Sept 4th…. …reported the exact same problem that I have. 

App constantly logs you out and doesn’t remember login credentials or use Face ID. 

Thus making it a totally useless app. 

Reporting it to support gets no resolution. 

I won’t even go into the hoops you have to jump thru to checkout… “how many ‘reusable’ bags did you use”?? I’m sorry but when I put most groceries, specifically meats, in a bag, I’m not reusing it. And what’s the other question about donating? I donate. On my own. I don’t need Sprouts to be my go between. But I guess they then reap the tax benefits having said “they” donated?

At least make our accounts remember our answer to that question so we don’t have to answer it every time. But then since i can’t get into the app to find my barcode it’s not gonna know who I am anyway. 

These are just a few of the reasons (along with the high prices on most things) I typically shop across the street at Kroger. They make the process much less frustrating and seem to value my business. 

Pros: decent produce sometimes at good prices, good sales on bulk food, sushi specials.

How can you expect a new customer to appreciate your brand/offerings if you can’t adjust the store location. I’m using the latest version of IOS on a IPhone 14. I’m not registering for an account with you until I’m confident that I want to do business with you and I should not have to give you my personal information just to price shop.

We love Sprouts!. We love having a store in Estero, Florida with healthy organic options, kind, helpful, employees, natural supplements, and savings incentives. Thank you Estero Sprouts.
We shop here bi-weekly or more and the personnel are fantastic. 
The Produce Dept. personnel sees us and know we want green organic bananas with short stems…
The Meat dept. knows our order by heart. 
From the prepared foods/bakery and deli depts. to the cashiers, people are professional, kind, and so very helpful.
 Jennifer, on the floor, and the Health and Wellness Mgr answer all questions with patience, knowledge, and smiles. 
We look for Janet and Nicole, at checkout, but appreciate others who help with care. 
Thanks for the cart care Marshall. 
Huge shout out and Thank you to all people who work at Sprouts Estero, FL Store!
Refund Takes 10 days!. Unbelievable, I ordered groceries on the app. My order was immediately canceled and I was given a response that’d I’d receive a refund in 5-10 days!
Excellent Customer Service. Everyone is very friendly and helpful which creates a very enjoyable shopping experience. They always provide fresh produce and meats when needed too!

Has the management changed?. Disappointed in selection and quality of fresh fruits and vegetables. Also much less organic options in FL . Nothing close to quality or choices at the Colorado. Management not as responsive or friendly.

Needs improvement. Does not use face recognition or other ways to login without typing in a password, and forgets credentials fast, very inconvenient. Search returns unrelated items. Half the time does no allow to submit a review- says complete mandatory fields which are not identified.
Also, the search engine is not searching. For instance, a simple word like ‘blueberries’ returns almost 300 items, very few of which are actually blueberries, you can find cucumbers, apples, oranges, and whole lot of other items. Very unhelpful.

Only one order but I believe we have a friendship that will last for a long time. Keep up the good work. I’m so happy you’re here and all your workers are doing such a fantastic job, I appreciate you. Thank you.

So I have to move it back to my home location and go through my entire list again). It is maddening. By the time I was ready to check out (for the third time) no slots are available until tomorrow, and 20/34 items are canceled. I’m sorry I was trying to avoid passing Covid to your staff and other people. Two hours later I am giving up. Seriously. Just go to the store. Boo Sprouts. Boo.

It is absolutely disgusting what our country has done to us and made us believe any of that food is okay at Walmart or wherever. We have been getting 0 nutrition for a very long time and I hope that Sprouts can eventually become the normal grocery store. We could be saving lives, but instead they’re poisoning their own people. Remember everyone the government would go bankrupt if they cared about us. Thank you so much Sprouts for your hard work and dedication. Your people would not have access without you.

Most of the time the app is correct but a few times I’ve not been able to find an item the app shows as the store having and neither can an employee tell me where it is. What would really make this app a five is if the aisle and shelf location were added to the product descriptions. This would save a lot of time and aggravation. If Target and Walmart can do it, so can Sprouts!

reviews.text: An Expression about Growing. I’ve shopped everywhere. I could name stores in Florida and southern Illinois an New York and North Carolina too. So how is the Sprouts experience helping me grow to be more concerned about the environment and the changes in myself I’d like to make. It provides kindness to a person who has experienced social troubles and disappointments. Which encourages me to think about my choices. Sometimes changes are harder to do but the Sprouts approach to going to a farmers market is where my family started in Rhode Island in 1690s. His name was Samuel Frances Colegrove and he was a sixteen year old farmer in the new world.

reviews.text: Items don’t match what’s on the menu.. Not reliable enough for someone who can’t make it to the store in person. Your at the mercy of the shopper that is picking your items. They don’t always grab the best looking items and if they forget something there’s no repercussions just a refund. So if they forget something you have to place another order and then get charged for the delivery fee since it’s under the minimum amount and wait for hours to get the missing item. Also when you pick your items and they don’t have them you get left with the options that are close to what you want but not what you need. It’s more reliable to go in person so if you can’t go, I wouldn’t be able to trust the quality of choices as well the people picking your items.

One of the worst grocery store apps. This app doesn’t work properly. At least not on iPhones. It only shows you the Scottsdale Arizona location and I’m nowhere near there. When you try to view deals for your actual location, it automatically opens the website in a browser. Unfortunately the website doesn’t work in Safari, which of course is the default browser for iPhones. This is the reason I had downloaded the app in the first place. It’s absolutely pointless. The only way to view the current sales is to go on a computer with Google Chrome as your browser, and who wants to use a browser that actively steals your personal info? Therefore your only way to actually see current sales is to drive all the way to the physical store location and hope they have an ad available. At that point, so much time has been wasted, it’s better to just shop at Raleys. I’m done shopping at Sprouts. They clearly don’t want customers or else they wouldn’t make it so difficult to view their current sale ads from iPhones and Apple products.

I live in a different county but if I have to go to Hoover I’m especially looking forward to going to Sprouts. As money gets tighter I don’t know if I can continue buying there but if there’s any chance of finding some deals I’ll always stop in. All of the employees from the fresh meat dept, produce, or any of the departments I may have questions about your employees are always friendly, helpful, and respectful. That speaks VOLUMES to me.
